signals.recommended_action: Fund FedNow/API layer as shared foundation rather than isolated payments project.

signals.signal: CFO capital skepticism is rational until programs show cost-to-income movement.
signals.recommended_action: Express every candidate AI move as cost-to-income, deposit retention, or regulatory-risk reduction.

signals.signal: CRO/model-risk gate must be explicit for AML, fraud, underwriting, and deposit-pricing AI.
signals.recommended_action: Add model-risk preclearance to P1/P2 gates.

signals.signal: Vendor optimization can self-fund parts of the modernization roadmap.
signals.recommended_action: Use Salesforce right-sizing and Q2 renegotiation as funding offsets.
